# natdal 0.1.0

The first public release of natdal: one small app in your tray, and the extensions you switch on.

## What's in it

- **clipmesh** — one clipboard across your computers, text and pictures, end-to-end encrypted; send files to your own devices.
- **inkshot** — Alt+S, drag, a few marks, Ctrl+C.
- **dialmix** — volume and monitor brightness from the keyboard and the wheel.
- **clickloop** — an auto clicker, and mouse and keyboard record-and-replay.
- **tools** — keep awake, a break reminder, always on top.
- **Command palette** — Alt+N (Option+N) to search every extension's commands.
- **Guildlings** — your coding agents as little characters on your desktop.
- **Agents** — every extension has a CLI and an MCP server. Agents may look by default and change nothing until you allow it.
- **Updates** — natdal checks for new versions and installs them when you say so (Settings → Updates). Stable and Beta channels.
- English and Korean.

## Install

- **Windows 10/11 (x64):** `natdal_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe`. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel):** `natdal_0.1.0_universal.dmg`, signed and notarized.

Each file has a `.sha256` next to it.

## Known limits

- Windows builds are not code-signed yet (certificate pending).

Questions and bug reports: support@natdal.app, or Send feedback… in the tray menu.
